name: Outdoor 582 Pure Cube Sauna with Shower
series: Outdoor 582 Pure Cube Sauna with Shower
description:
The Outdoor 5802Sauna With Shower - 3 Person DUAL Model is another sophisticated design that has a built in outdoor shower on 1 end with louvered privacy panels and stainless steel shower fixture. Create a calm and relaxing atmosphere with the optional semi-privacy panels that still have the double pane glass with a fixed cedar grill on the outside.

•	Comfortably Seats 3
•	Outdoor Shower
•	5.5' W x 8.3' L x 7.6 H (173x254x231cm)
•	Crafted from Canadian Clear or Knotty Red Cedar
•	Glass Sauna Door
•	2-Tier Benches
•	Tempered Glass Windows
•	Shower Hardware Included

* Please note: 
- The electric heater requires a certified electrician to hardwire the unit directly into your electrical panel.
- The shower fixture requires a plumber
